playbook_strategy: High Margin, Stable Demand (Cash Cow): Implement automated continuous replenishment with tight safety stock. High inventory turnover target.
High Margin, Moderate Volatility: Maintain dynamic safety stock buffer; establish automated weekly review with supplier.
Medium Margin, Stable Demand: Standard continuous ROP replenishment; automate PO generation.
Medium Margin, Moderate Volatility: Periodic weekly review (Order-Up-To); monitor seasonal shifts.
Medium Margin, Erratic Demand: Buffer against demand surges with safety stock; optimize purchase order batch sizes.
Low Margin, Stable Demand: Vendor-Managed Inventory (VMI) or bulk reorders with large pack sizes to minimize ordering costs.
Low Margin, Moderate Volatility: Periodic review with high review period; minimize management attention.
Low Margin, Erratic Demand (Tail Risk): Audit for strategic necessity (e.g. required accessory). If non-essential, liquidate or transition to drop-ship.
